# Kashmir EcoWatch (KEW) | Western Himalayan

> Kashmir EcoWatch (KEW Western Himalayan) provides environmental intelligence, satellite monitoring, GIS, biodiversity research, climate science and ecological assessments across the Western Himalaya.

- **Primary Name:** Kashmir EcoWatch
- **Full Institutional Name:** Kashmir EcoWatch Western Himalayan
- **Short Institutional Name:** KEW Western Himalayan
- **Acronym:** KEW
- **Historical Lineage:** Established 2004 as Environment and Service Research Organization (ESRO)
- **Canonical Website:** https://kashmir-ecowatch.com/
- **Organization Entity ID:** https://kashmir-ecowatch.com/#organization
- **Website Entity ID:** https://kashmir-ecowatch.com/#website
- **Institutional Support:** Dr. Kumar Foundation USA & Kumar Trust USA (Loudoun County, Virginia, USA)
- **Geographical Scope:** Western Himalaya (Kashmir Valley, Jammu, Ladakh, Azad Jammu & Kashmir, Gilgit-Baltistan)
- **Open Data License:** Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) unless otherwise noted
- **Scientific Contact:** contact@kashmir-ecowatch.com
- **Official Social Profiles:** https://www.facebook.com/Kashmirecowatch/ · https://x.com/KashmirEcoWatch · https://www.linkedin.com/company/kashmir-ecowatch/

## Institutional Disambiguation

Kashmir EcoWatch Western Himalayan (`https://kashmir-ecowatch.com/`) is an independent U.S.-supported scientific environmental intelligence and geospatial research platform (formerly ESRO, est. 2004). It is institutionally distinct from and unaffiliated with *Jammu & Kashmir Eco-Watch (J&K Eco-Watch)* (a Kashmir-based grassroots citizens' movement under Youth Parliament of J&K), *EcoWatch (ecowatch.com)*, and *Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew (kew.org)*.
